title: GTA6 Developer Tribunal: Final Hearing Begins for 31 Fired Staff
description: The final employment tribunal hearing between Rockstar Games and 31 fired GTA6 developers has begun in Scotland. Rallies and speeches outside as the case reaches its climax.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Final Hearing Begins in Scotland

The employment tribunal involving Rockstar Games and 31 fired GTA6 developers has officially commenced its final hearing in Scotland, according to media reports from Eurogamer. This legal showdown marks a critical chapter in a dispute that began when these developers were unceremoniously marched out of the company's offices last October.

## Rallies and Rousing Speeches

The opening of the final hearing was met with public rallies and powerful speeches. The affected developers, who lost their jobs late last year, gathered to make their voices heard. With sentiments echoing the powerful declaration, "Today, we are fighting fear," the former Rockstar staff stood united outside the tribunal venue.

## Context and Industry Impact

While the world eagerly awaits the release of GTA6, the turmoil behind the scenes highlights ongoing labor concerns within major game development studios. The outcome of this tribunal in Scotland could set a significant precedent for how large publishers handle workforce disputes and employee rights moving forward.

## Editor's Take

This tribunal brings much-needed attention to the human cost behind blockbuster game development. While players focus on trailers and release windows, the developers building these worlds deserve fair treatment and respect. We will continue to monitor this developing story closely.
